Free to try, one purchase to unlock everything

Build 6 added the planned purchase: try Claimball free, then unlock everything once. No ads, no subscription, and a Restore button.

In short: Claimball is planned to be free to try, with a single purchase that unlocks everything. There are no ads and no subscription, and a Restore button brings the unlock back. It is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android. The price has not been announced.

Build 6, a TestFlight internal test build, added how Claimball is planned to be paid for. It is not released to the public yet, and the price has not been announced.

Try first

Claimball is free to try. You can play and get a taste of the rivals before you decide anything.

One purchase

A single purchase unlocks everything. There are no ads and no subscription. The amount is shown by the store in your own currency when it is available.

Calm, not pushy

Locked rival cards simply look locked, and the purchase sheet is shown only at a few natural moments, such as after a match you won, at most once per launch. There is no pressure wording.

Restore and waiting

If you bought before, a Restore button in Settings brings the unlock back. If a purchase is waiting for approval, for example under Ask to Buy, the game waits instead of guessing.

If a purchase is refunded

A refund removes the unlock, but only after the game has seen the store say so on two separate launches, so a temporary sign-in glitch does not lock you out by mistake.

What is next

Claimball is still in testing and coming soon to iOS and Android. There is no release date yet.

FAQ

Can I try Claimball for free?

Yes. Claimball is free to try. You can play and get a taste of the rivals before you decide anything.

What does the purchase include?

A single purchase unlocks everything. There are no ads and no subscription. The amount is shown by the store in your own currency when it is available, and the price has not been announced.

What if I bought before or my purchase is pending?

A Restore button in Settings brings the unlock back. If a purchase is waiting for approval, for example under Ask to Buy, the game waits instead of guessing.

What happens if a purchase is refunded?

A refund removes the unlock, but only after the game has seen the store say so on two separate launches, so a temporary sign-in glitch does not lock you out by mistake.

About the game: Claimball is a casual duel game on a notebook grid for iOS and Android (coming soon, not yet released).
